Eight Mile made the amended action official yesterday, less than two weeks after initially suing…

items.title: Eminem’s Publishers Add 108 Examples to Copyright Lawsuit Against AI Platform Suno
Aussie MPs’ new AI proposals “disguise” pro-big tech copyright reforms as “a favour to creators”, says ARIA boss
items.summary: Australian MPs have published a report on AI, which talks about the need to protect creators and rightsholders, but also proposes significant copyright reforms to provide “the certainty necessary” for AI companies. The music industry says no such reforms are required, accusing MPs of “gaslighting”

items.summary: German music software company Ableton is the guinea pig on “Suno Bridge,” an initiative by the AI music heavyweight to integrate into the most popular DAWs. It might seem like a rough time for Suno to be rolling out new products, as the AI music company and its partners are actively facing major copyright infringement…

items.title: Caracas debatirá sobre música, inteligencia artificial y derechos de autor
Music may be excluded from Australia’s AI-friendly copyright reforms - though ARIA says “we stand with the rest of the creative and media industries”
items.summary: This week the creative and media industries came together to oppose AI-friendly copyright reforms being considered by the Australian government. It’s now being reported that those reforms might not actually impact on music, though the music industry says it remains committed to the wider campaign

items.title: Opinion published on Belgium’s new artist-remuneration right
items.summary: Not just any rando’s opinion either: this is an opinion by the advocate general at the Court of Justice of the European Union, Maciej Szpunar, so it carries weight. And the opinion is on a long-running battle over the way Belgium has implemented the European Copyright Directive. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Voz clonada: el derecho en juego suele no ser el copyright
tip.body: Imitar la voz de un artista con IA rara vez es infracción de copyright de la canción; el reclamo típico va por derechos de imagen, voz y publicidad, que varían mucho entre jurisdicciones.

tip.title: Cloned vocals: copyright is usually not the issue
tip.body: Mimicking an artist's voice with AI is rarely a copyright infringement of the song itself; claims typically run through name, image, voice and publicity rights, which vary widely by jurisdiction.
